title: Operator key moves to SSM SecureString /chatticus/<env>/thin-turn/operator-key
description: Part of story chatticus-a170754a (Secrets and generated keys live in SSM Parameter Store SecureString, created by infrastructure code); read its description for the full plan, order and hazards. Replace the OperatorKey Secrets Manager secret in infra/lib/thin-turn-stack.ts with the construct; FrontDoor (front-door-composition.ts) reads it with ssm GetParameter WithDecryption; env var CHATTICUS_OPERATOR_KEY_PARAMETER_NAME; IAM ssm:GetParameter on the exact ARN. Rotate instead of copy: only a human operator uses it, blast radius none. Three secrets saved (1.20 USD per month). Order: thin-turn deploy, then control-plane deploy, remove the old secret in a later deploy after cloudformation list-imports shows no importer of the operator-key-secret-arn export. Update docs/OWNER_CREDENTIAL_REVOCATION.md sections 6 and 2.1 and docs/OPERATOR_ORG_SEED.md.
